content: Hello, I am Cedar Insurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
Before we continue, I need to confirm your identity. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Thank you. Could you please tell me your postcode?

Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your motor premium has 480.00 past due and is 3 days late. Your home premium has 360.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your health premium has 720.00 past due and is 8 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount for all of them today?
I actually paid the motor arrears yesterday, and the home premium isn't mine. I'll pay the health premium today, though.
Thank you for letting me know. Posting may take two business days. I have noted that. To confirm: the health premium, 720.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. Do you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm the health premium only.
Your promise is recorded: the health premium, 720.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. A premium-promise receipt will be placed in the secure inbox. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thanks for your help. Goodbye.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
